title: GEMglColor3sv

messages.description: list of red, green and blue values of the current color

arguments.description: red value of the current color
green value of the current color
blue value of the current color

body: [GEMglColor3sv] calls glColor3sv() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glColor in the OpenGL reference.
